options.text: She doesn't usually cook, but she is cooking dinner today.
She isn't usually cooking, but she cooks dinner today.
She doesn't cook usually, but she cook dinner today.

questions.explanation: Привычка — Present Simple (doesn't usually cook), а сегодняшнее действие — Present Continuous (is cooking).

questions.text: Какие слова сигнализируют о Present Continuous? (выбери все верные варианты)
questions.explanation: Look!, Listen! и right now указывают на действие сейчас. Sometimes — сигнал Present Simple.
Right now — Present Continuous: aren't watching, are talking (для we).
Sometimes — сигнал Present Simple, she требует -s: cooks.

questions.text: Впиши правильную форму: I ___ (play) chess right now.
questions.explanation: Right now — Present Continuous, для I: am playing.
